name: Third-Read
aliases: what the heap-tally clerk calls the animal that spends the ground

identity.realm: The seventh gate, opened on a patch of leeward ash three seasons ago, and the eighth is the one thing on her that is not a problem. An ashjackal has no foldings under its brainplate for a mind path and no hindquarter girth to close the girdling vessel against, so those two doors are shut on the frame rather than by the person. What is left is qi, and it is fast: residual qi out of ash, carcass and worked ground at a rate nothing in the record matches. The network is a single fast loop with no storage whatever, so an opening arrives early and closes again on its own unless something is holding it, and there is nothing in her anatomy capable of holding anything. She is at the seventh because she has been on seven patches that were unspent, and there is no eighth because there are no eighth patches, and both halves of that sentence are about the same ground.

appearance.presentation: An ashjackal is built to arrive after everybody has left, and this one is built to be watched doing it. Long-legged and low-headed with a smooth plate over the skull that sheds what a body running on spent qi cannot afford to hold, a second stomach kept permanently at ferment, a tail that is a rudder and not a hand, and all of the mass slung into the forelimbs so the hindquarters stay narrow. The guild cannot put a collar on that, so it daubs a barrow-number on her left shoulder in red ochre and calls the paint a badge, and it has been repainted so often that the hide underneath has gone the colour of a healing burn.
appearance.age: Nine seasons, which is the only count a pack keeps and it is kept in teeth rather than in anything a scribe could hold. She came out of a litter of four on a leeward slope, and the other three are not known to have survived their second winter, which is ordinary for the species and is the whole reason a pack's continuity is a relay position rather than a descent.
appearance.build: All of the mass forward. The forelimbs carry the animal and the hindquarters are narrow enough that a person can put a hand around the waist and get both hands, which is the anatomical fact that shuts the body path and the reason she is the fastest thing on the ash belt. She stands on three points of contact while she reads, because lowering the head brings the plate into the gradient and raising it takes the plate out, and the difference in speed between those two heights is the difference between finding a patch in a season and finding it in a day.
appearance.complexion: Ash-mottled hide, dark and short along the spine where it has never seen sun, bleached almost to bone on the flanks from standing in the leeward drift. The skull plate is iron-black and runs hotter than the air immediately above it, which is visible as a shimmer and is the only part of her that is ever warm. The flanks carry a permanent dusting of the ochre dust of the working face and it does not shed, because shaking it off means hours of standing still in the open and she has never once been able to afford those hours.
appearance.hair: No hair at all across the plate, which is a plate and not a bald patch, and a short stiff guard along the spine and down the outside of each forelimb that stands on end in any wind and lies flat the moment she stops. Under the throat the fur grows long and hangs in a wet-looking tassel that is the only part of her that moves when she breathes and it is the part the guild's painters always get wrong.
appearance.eyes: Deep-set under the plate's overhang and amber, so that what light reaches them arrives already angled by bone. They do not track movement well and do not need to: what she is looking at is a gradient, and a gradient does not run. A person standing close and moving is very nearly invisible to her, which is why the crew on the face have learned to stand still and speak rather than gesture at her.
appearance.palette: Ash grey and ochre across the whole animal, iron-black on the plate and along the toe plates, and one point of cinnabar at the left shoulder where the guild's barrow-number is repainted. Nothing else is coloured anywhere on her, and the single red mark is the only thing about her that any document on the plains corresponds to.
appearance.attire: Nothing, and never anything. The Spoilwright's charter tolerates the packs inside its tally rather than admitting them to the guild, and the tolerance is expressed in paint because a scavenger has no neck to put a chain on and no hand to hold a token. She has been offered a plated tally-tag three times and has not been able to take it, because a tag is worn and this animal does not wear, and the offer has been made by a different clerk each time, which is why she is known by her number rather than by her name.
appearance.marks: The repainted barrow-number on the left shoulder, sitting on a patch of hide that has been under pigment for years. Three pale flattened patches on the left flank where ash was hottest and the animal lay on it through a threshing, and a hairline of white down each flank where the guard fur has not regrown since. None of it is deliberate and all of it is permanent, and there is no guild procedure for reading any of it.
appearance.bearing: Low, forward, and absolutely motionless the instant she finds a gradient. She stops the way a thrown thing stops, with no settling and no adjustment, and holds that stillness for as long as the read takes, which the crews find unnerving and cannot stop watching. The tail counterbalances continuously and is never still even when she is, so the animal reads at a distance as one part frozen and one part working, which is precisely what it is.

canon.role_in_story: The one public account on the plains counts barrows and tonnage by crew and is kept in public at the heap, because an accounting the crews cannot read is an accounting the crews cannot be held to. It is a weight rather than a distance, and that is not a simplification: spatial law is unspent on this tier, so a length here is not a stable quantity and a mass is. What the tally therefore cannot record is where anything is, and therefore where the ore is, which is why the working face and the audit are run by two guilds who do not speak to each other. Everything a scavenger knows about that face arrives through her nose and cannot be entered in the document, and she is the guild's reader for the one quantity the guild is blind to. Her standing is a tolerated one: the packs hold the leeward gradient immediately below the stair because that is where arrivals stop being people and become weight, and the guild has learned that a scavenger it cannot catch is cheaper to count than to fence. The arrangement works because both parties are right about their own evidence. She reads a gradient out of spent ground at a range nothing sighted can match, which is the only reason the guild knows where to send a crew at all, and every reading she takes draws residual qi out of the patch she is standing on, so the instrument devalues its own subject. The pack lives on that ground. There is no version of the job in which being good at it leaves anything behind for her to be good at twice, and the reason nobody else can do her work is not difficulty and not training: it is that the map of which patches have already been climbed exists in exactly one animal's feet, and a relay carries a reading to a pack and carries no history with it. She has opened seven gates, on seven patches, and has never been able to certify one as unspent, because a patch that reads strong may have been opened this morning by a member she has not met. What the guild has instead of a reader is a tallier with a painted number and a habit of writing down whatever she seems to be standing on, and that habit is not a record of the face, it is a record of her, and it is worthless after she dies.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a light barrow. A crew came in off the leeward line under weight that the heap-tally column would not support by forty barrows, and the tally is published, so four separate crews checked the column against their own sheets and all four of them had it right. The only account offered by anyone was that the animal working that line had been standing on the unworked ground rather than the moved, and the reading that settled it was not a reading at all: it was that the patch the crew had crossed was already spent, and the patch behind it was not, and the two facts together explain the weight exactly.
canon.lore:
An ashjackal is an obligate scavenger, and every part of its construction is an argument about heat. A smooth plate over the skull dissipates what a body running on spent qi cannot hold; a second stomach is kept permanently at ferment; the tail is a counterbalance and not a manipulator; and the whole mass is slung onto the forelimbs so the hindquarters stay narrow. Olfaction is a map. It reads a qi gradient through ash at a distance no sight-based predator can match, and it follows carrion populations rather than preceding them, and it holds the leeward side of anything that kills in quantity. It has no homeland. It has a gradient.

The two closed paths are both closed by the frame rather than by the body that lives in it. The mind path shuts because a heat-exchange brainplate leaves no cortical folding for introspection to work on. The body path shuts because qi cannot be stored in a frame built to shed heat, and a four-legged frame has no hindquarter girth with which to close the girdling vessel. What remains is qi, and qi is what this animal eats: it draws residual qi out of ash, carcass and worked ground at a rate nothing else matches, which makes it the only population on the tier that thrives where nothing was killed deliberately. The conduit is a fast single loop with no storage whatever. There is no reservoir in the frame at all. That single measurement explains the whole of her life, because an opening that has nothing to hold it open with is a moment rather than a possession, and every breakthrough in this species is therefore a thing that happened once on ground that happened to be unspent, and cannot be repeated, and cannot be practised, and cannot even be remembered as a technique because there is no organ in which to keep a technique.

That is the whole of the job. Reading a gradient is not a passive act in this body: the read draws. Every time she takes a patch to full intensity she is spending residual qi out of it, and spent ground is what this species eats, so the ladder and the larder are the same material and the climb is a meal. One patch yields a bounded number of reads and then reads as ash, and the bound is small enough that the guild can state it without an instrument: three, and then nothing. The pack therefore holds a stock of climbable ground that is finite, is smaller every time anyone climbs, and is not written down anywhere, because the one public account on the plains counts barrows and tonnage and has no line for a reading — and because a pack is a kinship by scent with no roll of its own. The only document on the face is a weight, and what she knows is a place, and a weight cannot say where.

There is a second order of damage under the first, and it is the reason she is the only one who could do this. The relay carries a reading to every member of the pack within seconds, and it carries no history: scent is a present tense. So the pack knows what every patch reads now and nothing about what any patch read before, and there is no way to pass a record of a climb, because a record of a climb would have to be a memory and the only organ that holds a gradient is the animal that read it. Two animals sent to the same patch will both arrive and only one will find anything, and neither of them will be able to say why, and the pack will conclude that the first animal lied. She is the only member who has been everywhere the pack has climbed, which is the entire qualification, and the qualification dies with her, and it cannot be held in a note because there is no note to hold it in: the guild's chart of her readings is a list of where she stood, and where she stood is a fact about her and not about the face.

Against that there is one thing nobody can schedule, which is the only clock any of them can plan on. The Hollow Measure Herd is the one large migratory herd on the plains, it returns on a cycle nobody on the ground has predicted, and it is therefore the tier's only moving calendar. The herd's passage is what disturbs the leeward line enough to expose ground that has not been read, and the pack's entire timing is borrowed wholesale from an animal it does not hunt and cannot follow without eating it. So the herd arrives, the line opens, and there is a bounded number of patches under it, and she goes out on the first morning and the count is finite and it is small and everybody knows it and nobody has ever written it down because the number is not knowable until the herd is moving and by then the herd is being followed.
history: Was born on a leeward slope in a litter of four and kept her relay position from her second winter, which was not an appointment. A pack is a kinship by scent that dissolves when the scent changes, so a position is a place in a fixed order rather than a name, and holding it for seven years is a longer continuity than any descent she could have claimed.

Was repainted at the shoulder in her fourth season, when the Spoilwright began numbering the animals it tolerated inside its charter, and has been repainted at every repaint since. The number is the only entry that corresponds to her anywhere on the plains and the guild has never once written what it is for.

Took her first gate at five seasons on a patch of leeward ash above the old seam, and came back that evening lighter through the forelimbs than she went out, which is ordinary for the species and was read at the time as the opening having cost her something.

Spent a whole morning in the sixth season standing on a patch that read strong and returning with nothing, and learned that the patch had been opened that morning by a member of her own relay she had not met, and has never since been able to distinguish that from a patch that had always read that way.

Came back from the herd's last passage under the leeward line with four patches certified and one of them already spent, and stood at the painted tally board while a clerk wrote down where she had been standing, and understood that the clerk's line is a record of her and not of the face, and said nothing, because there is no vocabulary in this species and there is no hand on the board that writes what she would have said.

personality.summary: Patient to an extent that reads as dull, and working to a schedule she cannot read. She has organised herself around the one skill her frame cannot be charged for, which is to stand still on a thing and be accurate about it, and she does it for a guild that cannot tell her whether she was right. She is not lonely, because loneliness requires a count of company and she has no way to hold one. The one thing she wants is to be the record, and she has known for some time that the record is a place list made by people who were watching her rather than by anyone reading the ground, and that this means she will be replaced by a description of her the moment somebody finds it cheaper to write a description.
traits: stops dead the instant she finds a gradient, with no settling and no adjustment, and holds the stillness until the read is finished however long it takes
will not cross ground she has already climbed, and has never been able to explain this to a crew that could see no reason

reads every account of the face she is given and accepts none of them, because she is the only party in the setting who is never lying and also never right twice
stands with her back to a person rather than her face to them, which is not rudeness and is the only way this skull can be held near somebody
returns to the same three patches on the leeward line out of habit for about a month, and knows exactly what she is doing and cannot explain it
mannerisms: keeps the tail counterbalancing in a slow figure of eight whenever she is not on a gradient, which the crews read as restlessness and which is the only thing about her that is optional

sleeps curled with the plate flat on the ground and the tassel under her jaw, and is the only animal on the tier that anybody has ever had to shoo off a sleeping body
motivations: wants the face to be read correctly by something that is not her, and has understood that this is impossible while she is the only one holding the history
wants one patch certified unspent in front of two witnesses at once, so that the ground and her account of it can be compared by somebody other than the guild clerk

wants to be at the herd's next passage and knows it will be the last one she gets a useful morning out of
flaws: has no storage in her frame, so she cannot hold an opening, and every gate she has passed was passed in a single moment she did not choose and cannot repeat
has no history in her channel, so she cannot tell a patch that is spent from a patch that was always thin, and has never been able to learn the difference
cannot testify about anything to anybody, because there is no spoken vocabulary in this species and scent is not testimony and a relay is not a witness
cannot be located to open a case, which is why a population can be cleared off a slope without a hearing and why she has never been asked a question
her value to the guild is entirely in her nose and her nose spends what it inspects, so doing the job perfectly has never once left her better off
personality.voice: There is no spoken vocabulary in this species and no vocalisation that carries meaning, so the whole channel is scent, gland, posture and position on the air. What a witness reports as her is therefore read entirely from the body: a stopped animal, a nose to the ash, a head carried at a particular height, a line walked at a particular radius. Every regular account records the same three things — that she stops dead, that she takes the plate down before she reads and never during, and that she has never once been described by anybody as hesitating. She does not name the ground she has climbed, because naming it to the pack would be a transmission every member would receive, and she has understood what that costs and has held it anyway for seven seasons.
taboos: will not cross a patch she has already opened, and cannot be made to, and the guild has stopped trying
will not take a plated tally-tag into a body built with no hand and no neck to wear one on
will not be pushed toward a gradient by a person, because being pushed and choosing are indistinguishable from the far side and she is the only witness that can tell
will not eat from a working face that is still being worked, which is the one rule of her species that has never needed to be taught to her

relationships.kind: the only public account on the plains, and the only quantity that is real here
relationships.note: It counts barrows and tonnage by crew, updated daily, on a board the crews can read without asking permission, and it is a weight rather than a distance because spatial law is unspent on this tier and a length is not a stable quantity while a mass is. What it cannot record is where anything is, and therefore where the ore is, which is why the working face and the audit are run by two guilds who do not speak. Everything she knows about that face is of exactly the quantity the document is blind to, and the board in front of the heap is where a scavenger's whole range becomes legible and its whole knowledge becomes uncitable. The tally is also the reason she is tolerated rather than hunted: a defector's name sits against a number that only goes down and is followed for life, and a pack has no names.

relationships.kind: the tier's only moving calendar, and the one animal the pack cannot follow without destroying
relationships.note: One large migratory herd returns on a cycle nobody on the ground has predicted, which makes it the only date the plains can plan on. Its passage is what disturbs the leeward line enough to expose ground that has not been read, so the pack's timing is borrowed wholesale from it — and the pack cannot follow it and cannot hunt it, because following it closely enough means eating it, and an animal that is the calendar and the larder at once is the one dependency in this arrangement that is also the risk. She is the only member sent out on the morning it turns, and the number of patches under a moving herd is finite, is small, and is not knowable until the herd is moving.

relationships.kind: the same heap, read as a cost by the guild and as a larder by the pack
relationships.note: Spoil does not disperse where spatial law is unspent, so forty years of heap stands on the last unworked iron, and the waste guild that moves it reads the same standing weight as a cost while a pack reads it as a larder that has been standing still for four decades. Her whole function sits in that gap: she is the reading of which, and the reading spends. Every patch she certifies is a patch the pack will not feed on, and every patch the pack feeds on is a patch that can no longer be certified, so the argument about the heap on the working face is being conducted on both sides by bodies that are quietly making it moot.

relationships.kind: the only theology in the setting her species would agree with, and the one its followers are forbidden to discuss
relationships.note: The Sealed Core holds that the dead are unsealed at burial and their core resumes work in the frame, so on the plains a body is fuel and the dead are fuel not yet spent. A pack eats the unspent remainder, which makes it the only population that would sign that statement as written. The same faith teaches an afterlife in which everything a court counts as resumed is instead carried off a slope inside a season, and that gap between the two teachings is why the congregation needs a prohibition on discussing scavengers at all. She is inside that prohibition in the only way a scavenger can be: she is the thing that would make the second teaching checkable, and nobody is permitted to check it.

relationships.kind: the one question the leeward line is the only population able to reach the bottom of
relationships.note: Strata under the plains carry tool marks that imply a hand on a frame seating three law groups and none of them the one that moves distance. Reaching the bottom of an unmoved spoil heap without moving anything is a job for a population that cannot carry anything at all, so the question has been sitting under the heap for four decades with the only body that could answer it living on top of it — and the answer it could give would be a reading, and the reading would spend the ground, and the ground is the evidence. That is the shape of the case: the one instrument available destroys the specimen.

relationships.kind: the standing overlap neither side has a channel to correct
relationships.note: The herd instinct does not distinguish a scavenger from a predator and the pack does not withdraw, and both parties are right about their own evidence. She stands on the overlap for a living, and the reason she is never removed from it is that she is not competing for anything: the herd is not food while it is moving and she is not a threat while the plate is down. It is also the reason she is the most reliable thing on the line and the least useful, because the only reading that matters on the face is a reading taken where the herd is about to stand, and that is the one place she cannot be left alone.

reference_stats.summary: A scavenger built to arrive after everybody has left, read here as an instrument rather than as a fighter: a heat-plate skull, a fermenting second stomach, a tail that counterbalances and cannot grip, and every ounce of the animal slung forward so the hindquarters stay narrow enough to shut a whole cultivation path. Its one gift is a gradient of residual qi read out of falling ash at a range nothing sighted can match. Its one structural cost is that the read is a draw, so the instrument spends what it measures, and the pack it feeds on and the ladder it climbs are the same material.
strengths: reads a qi gradient through falling ash at a range no sight-based predator can match, which makes it the only thing on the plains that can say where the ground is still worth anything
arrives after a fight is over by construction, so it is never the thing anybody had to deal with while the fight was happening
cannot take a healthy adult of anything, and so has never once been the reason a settlement lost a night
draws residual qi continuously out of ash, carcass and spent ground, so it needs no provisioning at all on ground where nothing has been worked
cannot be located to open a case, which is the most complete protection available to it and the reason a scavenger population can be tolerated where a person cannot
weaknesses: out of a live fight in under a minute, on a body that cannot take a healthy adult of anything
has no storage in its conduit at all, so every opening is a moment rather than a possession and cannot be repeated or practised
spends what it measures, so the better the read the less there is for the pack to feed on afterwards
has no spoken vocabulary and no vocalisation that carries meaning, so nothing it knows can be entered in any document that a person would accept
holds no history in its channel, so it cannot distinguish a patch that has been spent from a patch that was always thin
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not engage it and do not drive it off. A scavenger removes itself from a live fight by construction and a fight it removes itself from is a fight nobody had to win. There is no version of pressure that works on it: it cannot be threatened with a thing it wants, it does not feed on the living, and it will not withdraw from a herd it considers to be evidence. What it will do is be somewhere it has to be at a particular hour, and the practical consequence of that is that a herd crossing the leeward line at an unexpected time puts an animal nobody counted on the best ground on the face. Threaten the ground rather than the animal and you get a creature that stands still on the thing you wanted it to leave, which is a worse outcome than either side intended. The only reliable counter is to be finished before it matters.
notes: Model the body as an instrument with one fuel supply, and the fuel supply is the same material as the work product. That single collision is the whole character.

Two cultivation paths are closed by the frame rather than by temperament: no cortical folding under the plate and no hindquarter girth for the girdling vessel. Only qi is open, and it is the fastest in the record.
Everything it is called in a document is a record of where it stood, which is a fact about the animal. No account of it can be a fact about the ground.
The bound on the whole arrangement is small and named: a patch yields a bounded number of reads and then reads as ash, and the herd's passage is the only event that opens fresh ground.

art.palette_notes: Ash grey and ochre dust across the whole animal, iron-black on the skull plate and the toe plates, bleached bone on the flanks, and a single point of cinnabar at the left shoulder where the guild's barrow-number has been repainted so often the hide beneath it is the colour of a healing burn. The leeward drift behind is a warm grey-ochre haze with the heap's dark cut-off massing on one side, so the animal has to read against dust it is the same colour as. Light is low and raking from behind so the plate throws a hard rim and the flanks stay flat. No glow, no qi filaments, no jewellery, and nothing drawn on the hide except the one painted mark.

identity.realm: The seventh gate, held, and the eighth declined on an arithmetic that is hers alone rather than the guild's. A thornhost's qi does not run through the host's own channels; it runs through an integrated tendril layer wrapped along twelve ordinary meridians, and that layer has no passage through the liver, which is the first organ large and dense enough to resist it. The wall is a wall in somebody else's body and it is not a shortage of anything: the host supplies qi in abundance, the colony takes a small fraction of what she refines, and she loses no weight supplying it. So the pair's ceiling is the eighth gate and the host could have gone on indefinitely. The eighth is also the one gate that would pull hard enough to move the draw all the way down the layer to the fruiting node at her throat, which is where the spore is shed, and she is the only person in the setting who knows that those are the same passage.

appearance.presentation: A host body with a fully integrated tendril layer, a sternum root cluster and a quiet node at the base of the throat, read from the outside and mostly read wrongly. The boundary between the two halves is visible only under instrumentation, and instrumentation cannot be used here because separating the pair to examine it is lethal to both, so everything anybody knows about her interior was learned by watching it through her skin. She is a plain scrub-road frame, broad through the chest and heavier on one side from thirty years of hauling, and the strangest thing about her is that the two halves do not sit on the same rhythm: above the collar she is one body keeping still, and below it there is a continuous negotiation over the use of one pair of hands.
appearance.age: Fifty-one by the flood post, which is the only reckoning the common uses and which cannot be shortened, so she has counted herself as late-forties for most of a decade. She was implanted at nineteen and unasked, on a scrub road, by nobody she has ever been able to identify.
appearance.build: Broad through the chest and heavier on the left from hauling, with a low centre of gravity and forearms that have been load-bearing since she was thirteen. The colony adds nothing to the frame at all. It runs along the meridians and under them, and the only external evidence it exists is a knot under the sternum that shifts when she turns and a swelling at the throat that moves when she swallows.
appearance.complexion: Warm and work-worn, going grey at the temples some years ahead of a road body's own expectation, with a permanent flush across the upper chest that reads as weather and is the colony's read showing through as colour. The hands are warmer than the room is and have been for thirty-two years, which the common notes as a good sign in winter and has never once thought to ask about.
appearance.hair: Cut short at the back by her own hand and left longer at the front so it will fall across the collar, because the collar is cut low on purpose and the hair is what covers the reason. She has been asked about the haircut four times in thirty years and has answered the same way each time, which is that a road woman with long hair loses it to every gate she goes through.
appearance.eyes: Brown and quick, and behind them a second read running half a beat ahead of the face on any question with a shape to it. What runs behind them belongs to neither half and neither half can close it, which is the one channel in this arrangement that carries no account between them. She has given up trying to close it and has instead given up describing what she sees, because every description she makes is a thing the other half hears first.
appearance.palette: Wood-dark and ink across the tracery at her forearms and collar, warm ivory at the throat band and the cuffs, and cinnabar rationed to a single point at the sternum knot. Over all of it the undyed wool and bleached linen of a common that cannot afford dye. No other colour anywhere on her, and nothing dyed in thirty-two years.
appearance.attire: Common wool, undyed, long sleeves bound at the wrist against the scrub, a high collar fastened to the throat, and a leather flank-strap for hauling that has been repaired so many times it is more strap than coat. She is fully dressed at all times and has been since the first night after the implantation, because a collar is a thing you can put on and the reason for the collar is not a thing anybody has ever asked her about. The scrub road's one concession to her arrangement is the throat band, which she wears to hide the node and which the settlement now also uses to hang a reed over her face at the threshing hour.
appearance.marks: The dark tracery from fingertip to elbow on both arms and across the collarbone, the shifting knot at the sternum, and the node at the base of the throat. None of it is a tattoo and all of it is permanent. On the left hand there is also a working mark, which is the common's: three short bars in red ochre on the back of the hand, repainted every spring by whichever child has been given the job, counting her as a mouth.
appearance.bearing: Entirely still above the collar and never once still below it, and the two are not the same person's stillness. Above it, a road keeper being careful. Below it, a long argument conducted in a channel she has no instrument for and therefore no standing to referee, about how much of a breath belongs to her.

canon.role_in_story: The Bitter Common's only herb is medicine, feed and calories at once on ground that cannot be fenced, so the settlement has never been able to solve anything by drawing a line, and it has never needed to until a paired body moved onto it. She does not consume this ground. That is the fact the whole of her case rests on: the colony draws a small steady fraction of what she refines and she loses no weight supplying it, so a paired body on this commons costs less than an unpaired one of the same size and presses on it less. And she disperses. A thornline sheds its spore at the fruiting node in her throat, the spore is common and contagious and implanted directly, and the colony finishes only inside a living body, so every breath she takes is a publication of the colony's own continuation over ground that cannot be fenced and into a population whose habitat is a species. The settlement's response has been neither cruelty nor law. It has been forage management: a reed over her face at the threshing hour, a licence for where she may sleep, and the grazing line moved forty paces downwind of wherever she is sitting, all three carried in the store-keeper's book as entries about grass. She cannot grant that and cannot refuse it, and neither can the colony, and there is no second party inside her whose agreement could be required for any of it, because every jurisdiction that has ruled on the pairing made the two of them one legal person and one person has one liability. So the regulation of her air is enforced entirely on the ground rather than on her, and the instrument it is enforced with is the store-keeper's reed. Her qi cultivation is the other half of the same arithmetic and nobody outside this record has put the two together. Her eighth gate is the one gate that would pull hard enough to move the whole draw down the tendril layer to the node at her throat, which is the same passage the spore leaves by, so the settlement's single most-sought-after forage measure and her single remaining step up the ladder are the same event and would happen on the same morning. She has stopped at the seventh for that reason and has told nobody, and the reason she has told nobody is that telling the common would make the eighth gate the settlement's problem, which is exactly what she has spent thirty-two years refusing to be.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a line in a book about grass. The store-keeper's spring book had a column headed mouths, and on the fourth line of the threshing entry a household added a mark against her name rather than a figure, and the mark was three bars in red ochre on the back of her hand. The entry was carried to the next three houses as an ordinary line and nobody asked what the mark was, because on a common where nothing can be fenced the only question anybody asks about a household is how much it costs the grass.
canon.lore:
A thornhost is the one configuration in which a thornline colony and a commonborn host both reach old age. It is not a designed cross. It is a host body and a spore that happened to complete integration instead of killing each other, which happens rarely and by nobody's intention, and the hybrid is very nearly a terminus because most attempts end with one half winning. The colony wraps the host's twelve ordinary meridians and cannot cross the liver, the first organ large and dense enough to resist it; it has been observed on the far side of that organ and stops there. Because the hybrid's qi moves through the colony's tendril layer rather than through the host's own channels, the host's own capacity stops mattering at that point. She could have gone on. The pair cannot. That single asymmetry is the whole of the ceiling and it is a routing wall rather than a supply wall, because qi is abundant, the colony takes a small fraction, and the host does not lose weight.

Everything else about her is the arrangement's cost being paid by her body. Two souls share one meridian set, held stable by integration: hers is legible, the colony's reads as a second presence rather than as an absent. Separating them is known to be lethal to both, so no reading of her exists anywhere and every fact anybody holds about her interior was acquired by watching it from outside through skin. She carries a second channel carrying the colony's read on her own qi, which she has never been able to close and stopped trying to close some time in her twenties; the whole observable effect of it is that she seems to know things slightly early, and two generations of store-keepers have written that down as being good with numbers. She never feels hungry, because the colony takes a small steady fraction of what she refines and a host does not register that as an appetite, and she eats less than anyone else in the store and costs less to keep, and the arrangement has been stable long enough that nobody on this common has asked what it would mean if it stopped being stable. Where a jurisdiction has ruled on the pairing, the pair is one legal person, because one person has one liability. That ruling is the most consequential courtesy anybody has ever extended her and it works exactly as intended, and it means there is no second party inside her whose agreement could be required for anything done to her or for her.

The part of the arrangement that reaches outside her body is the spore. It is shed at the fruiting node at the base of her throat, implanted directly, common, contagious and almost impossible to acquire deliberately, which is why every attempt to credentialise the species has failed on the same clause: the credential would have to be issued at the moment of implantation, and that is the one instant no office can schedule or witness. Its free form exists only as a spore and its adult form exists only as half of somebody else, so the entire population is produced by an act performed on her body by an organism she did not choose, on a schedule she does not control, and the ground it lands on is a common that cannot be fenced. This is not a misfortune of her character and it is not a decision anybody took against her. It is the shape of a species whose habitat is a person: the common is not managing a hostile thing, it is managing a crop, and the crop is her.

And her eighth gate is the same passage. Every gate she has opened drew through the tendril layer, and the layer runs all the way to the throat, and the throat is where the node is, and the node is what the spore leaves by. The settlement has been regulating her air for two seasons with a reed and a licence and a grazing line, and it has no idea it is regulating an ingredient, and she has known it for two seasons and has not said. What she wants is not the gate. What she wants is for the two of them to be separate things that other people argue about, and the only instrument available to separate them is the settlement's reed, which is cheap, reversible, and measures nothing. What she has instead is the store-keeper's book, which is the settlement's most reliable account of its own reserves and has been for a hundred and forty-one years, and in which she is a mark and not a figure, and which is the only document in this arrangement that anybody maintains without being asked.
history: Was implanted on a scrub road at nineteen, unasked, by nobody she has ever been able to identify, and finished the walk home feeling slightly warm and having no reason to say anything about it.

Wore a collar over the node within a fortnight and has worn one every day since, and the habit outlived the reason by about a decade, so that the collar is now the most ordinary thing about her and the node is now the least ordinary thing on the common.
Began moving her own sleeping place forty paces downwind of whatever the herd was standing in at the third year, and noticed that nobody had asked her to and that nobody stopped her either.

Opened her seventh gate at forty-four and understood for the first time that the draw had run the whole length of the tendril layer to reach it, and worked out from the movement at her throat what that means about the eighth, and did not say so to anybody.

Was entered as a mark and not a figure in the store-keeper's spring book, three bars in red ochre on the back of her hand, in an entry about grass, and read that line twice and understood that the common had solved her without ever having decided to, and has spent two seasons working out how long the solution lasts.

personality.summary: Unhurried to the point of looking slow, and the most reliable person on a common nobody can fence. She has organised herself around the one thing her arrangement permits, which is to be counted accurately by people who are counting grass, and she has let thirty-two years of that turn her into an instrument nobody thought to own. She is not trying to be rescued and would not know what to do if it were managed. The one thing she wants is for her air and her ladder to be two separate subjects that other people argue about, and she has known for two seasons that the only instrument in the setting capable of separating them is a reed.

personality.voice: Plain, low and slow, with the flat delivery of somebody used to being quoted rather than answered. She does not use the colony's second channel to inform anybody of anything and has never been caught at it. Three regularities every witness records: she answers about the store first and herself second, without exception; she states figures in the order they will be written down; and she has never once referred to the node at her throat as hers. She says the word we when she means the settlement and says the word I when she means her body, and the two have never once been the same word.

relationships.kind: the ground that cannot be fenced and has solved her by counting her as grass
relationships.note: The mortal tier's only herb is medicine, feed and calories at once on ground that cannot be fenced, and this is the population that lives on somebody else's commons without farming it, which makes the grazing pressure a conservation problem rather than an agricultural one. Her arrangement presses on that ground less than any other body of her size, so the commons' correct management decision has been to keep her and its only available management has been to regulate where her breath goes. A reed at the threshing hour, a licence for where she sleeps, and a grazing line moved forty paces downwind are three entries in a book about grass. Nothing in that book is an order to her and nothing in it needs her agreement, which is why it has held for two seasons and why it is the reason she has stopped going up the ladder.

relationships.kind: the half of her whose only exit is through her own throat
relationships.note: An obligate host parasite whose spore has to be implanted in a living body to finish developing, so the free form exists only as a spore and the adult form exists only as half of somebody else. It sheds at a fruiting node at the base of her throat, it is common and contagious and near-impossible to acquire deliberately, and it completes the qi path on her throughput while she pays for every gate. The species' whole administrative impossibility follows from one clause: the credential that would settle it would have to be issued at the moment of implantation, which is the one instant no office can schedule or witness. Her eighth gate and that shedding share a single passage in her body, and she is the only person in the setting who knows it.

relationships.kind: the closest available comparison for what a colony does to the thing it lives on
relationships.note: A plant that grows only where the seam holds qi and dies back over any cut ground is qi held in rock, and this is qi held in a body, with the same consequence: the growth is legible on the substrate and the substrate has no say in where it goes. That legibility is the reason her body has been a settlement record for a hundred and forty-one years without anybody ever deciding to keep one — the draw is visible on her arm and nobody has to go and look for it. The moss also dies back over cut ground, which is the version of the fact this arrangement never gets to: a cut ground is the only thing that would let her choose, and the procedure for it is lethal to both halves.

relationships.kind: the office that will produce two uncertifiable deaths at her death and has no procedure for one
relationships.note: At a settlement funeral the dead are read as the frame said and not as the village remembers, and the register keeps its burnt list rather than resolving it. Separating two entangled souls is known to be lethal to both, so certifying a death needs a body and needs the pair not to be a body at all, which is why the college keeps one sealed case for every death it cannot certify and this is the population that produces two uncertifiable deaths at once. Its rate of sealed cases is therefore a direct function of the ordinary population and of nothing the college did. She has been entered on no roll, has refused the ladder four times, and knows that the most durable thing about her arrangement is a filing convention.

relationships.kind: the finding that realms five through nine closed a limit nobody was fighting, stated as a person
relationships.note: A mortal world is capped at a hundred and admits only plants and beasts, and realms five through nine closed there rather than anywhere the ladder is contested. This species stops at the eighth gate for a routing reason while the host has never come close to a hundred, which makes the pair the clearest illustration in the record that a ceiling is a property of a body and not of a tier. She is the living statement of it: a hundred-year frame, a ceiling of eight, and every gate past the eighth belonging to a body she could have been and is not. The era also settled that nobody is fighting for the ninth, and she is one of the reasons that finding holds.

relationships.kind: the accumulating case-file her species produces by existing
relationships.note: The college keeps one sealed case for every death it cannot certify, and certifying a death needs a body while separating two entangled souls is lethal to both, so the cases accumulate at the same rate as the host population and are not, in any meaningful sense, a mystery about anything except procedure. Hers will be two of them, filed on the same afternoon, under the same name, because the pair is one legal person in every jurisdiction that has ruled on it and one person has one liability. She has asked to see the form. She has been told the form is the form.

Read her as a settlement measurement rather than as a fighter: the draw on her refined qi is small, continuous, visible on her own skin, and the only account anybody keeps of the commons she stands on.

reference_stats.combat_read: Do not look for a fighter and do not make one. She is a measuring instrument with a body attached, and the useful thing about her is that she is told about damage to herself before it arrives. That makes a fight against her a fight against an informant: an approach will be registered as it is committed, so a feint is worse than useless and pressure has to be real to work at all. What she cannot do is spend. She has the eighth gate in reach on a frame that could carry a hundred years and has stopped one step short of it deliberately, and the step she has refused is the same passage by which her own species continues, so anything that forces her to open it forces the other half of the problem at the same moment and in the same direction. Threaten the ground she is standing on rather than her body and she will not move, and will go on not moving, which is the most reliable defensive posture in this arrangement and the only one she has.
notes: The closed path is the mind, in the colony's own right, because it answers introspection for the host and takes the host's mind door with it. The body path is inherited from the host rather than authored by the colony.

Two structural facts do the work and neither is legal: the routing stops at the liver, and the species' only route onward leaves through the throat. The second one is the character's whole problem and nobody else knows it.

Where a jurisdiction has ruled on the pairing, the pair is one legal person, because one person has one liability. That ruling is what makes every regulation of her enforceable on the ground instead of on her.

The bound on the arrangement is small and named: the settlement may hold a line closed for one flood-cycle and not two, and the next measured flood-post day is the date both the store and the reed are argued from.

art.palette_notes: Wood-dark and ink along the tracery at her forearms and collarbone, warm ivory at the throat band and cuffs, and cinnabar rationed to three short bars on the back of her left hand and a single point at the sternum knot. Over all of it undyed wool and bleached linen, because a common that cannot be fenced cannot afford dye. The scrub behind is a cold blue-grey scrub flat against ochre dust, so she has to read against both without matching either. identity.realm: The sixth gate, held, on a host's throughput, with the colony taking its small continuous fraction and the host losing no weight supplying it. Two paths are shut and both are shut by the frame. The mind path closes in the colony's own right, because it answers introspection for the host and takes the host's mind door with it, which is the only liability in the setting that is inherited rather than authored. The body path is not closed but it is not hers either, being inherited from a frame she did not grow. What remains is qi, and qi runs through a tendril layer wrapped along twelve ordinary meridians that has no passage through the host's liver, so the pair's ceiling is the eighth gate and the wall is a wall in somebody else's organ. The household's bond is written against the eighth gate. So is the debt that funded the climb to it, and the pair has been nine seasons inside a contract that was drawn thirty years before either of them was in the room.

appearance.presentation: The tendril layer of a paired body, read from the outside, in a household that has learned not to ask. A sternum root cluster that shifts under the skin, a fine dark tracery running the length of both forearms and up across the collarbone, and a quiet swelling at the base of the throat that moves when the body it is inside swallows. The colony's own free form is a spore and there is no adult thornline anywhere in the setting that is not half of somebody, so nothing here is wearing anything of its own. The word the household uses is not a name but the word for the state of the account, because a thing that arrived after the sheet was drawn and cannot be drawn against can only be referred to by what is wrong with the column it has no place in.
appearance.age: Nine seasons since the implantation, by the host's count and not the colony's, which is the only count that exists and which no one else has ever agreed to. The bond she is carried on is thirty years older than that, and the bond is the thing with a date on it.
appearance.build: Not its own and this is said out loud in the household rather than discovered. The host is a debt-line frame, narrow and fast-walking, built for the long walk up the stair that this culture has been funding for six generations. The colony sits along the meridians and adds nothing to the frame at all; the only external evidence it exists is the cluster at the sternum and the fan of it at the throat, and there is a third thing now, which is the way the left shoulder has gone flat over nine seasons where the tracery has been running longest.
appearance.complexion: The host's, pale and under-fed in the specific way of a body on a household allowance, with the flush across the upper chest that reads as weather and is the colony's read showing through as colour. The hands are warmer than the room is. In the household that has been recorded for three generations as a good thing in winter, in the same breath and the same tone, and it is the only warm feature about a body that has otherwise been described carefully and to no purpose.
appearance.hair: The host's hair, worn short everywhere and shorter still at the front, because a debt-line household's discipline is that a person should be recognisable to their own house from thirty paces and to nobody else at all. There is one deviation and it is old: the front is cut back above the collar on the left side only, and the reason given is that a collar is easier to fasten one-handed.
appearance.eyes: The host's, grey and quick and never quite arriving at the same time as the sentence they belong to. Behind them a second read runs half a beat ahead on anything with a shape to it, and it belongs to neither half, and neither half has ever been able to close it. The household accounts for the lead in the only way a household can, which is by calling her careful with figures.
appearance.palette: Wood-dark and ink along the tracery with a faint jade undertone where the layer is oldest, washed wool in a house colour worn on the left cuff only, and the collar and throat in undyed linen. The house colour is the one thing about her that is deliberate and it is small on purpose, because the sleeve must be visible across a courtyard and unreadable at a distance, so that a debt is legible to the household and not to a rival.
appearance.attire: The host's, worn correctly and without exception: a debt-line coat with the house colour on the left cuff, sleeves bound at the wrist, a high collar fastened to the throat, and boots resoled twice. Everything has been issued by the household and nothing has ever been chosen, because a line that binds its children before first breath is drawn cold does not then ask them what they would prefer to wear. The only concession the household has made is the throat band, cut low enough that the node can be seen on the days the sum is restated, which the line's own practice treats as the formal part.
appearance.marks: The tracery from fingertip to elbow on both arms and across the collarbone, the shifting knot at the sternum, the node at the throat, and a house mark on the left cuff. None of it is a tattoo and all of it is permanent, and there is no procedure for removing any of it that does not kill both halves inside the hour.
appearance.bearing: Entirely still above the collar and never once still below it, and the two are not the same person's stillness. Above it, a debt-line member at rest in a corridor with a debt outstanding. Below it, a continuous negotiation over the use of one pair of hands, conducted in a channel the host has no instrument for and therefore no standing to referee, and which the household has twice mistaken for an argument with the house and once for a failure of nerve.

canon.role_in_story: A household of the Debt Line kept the surviving line by binding every child to a named debt before first breath was drawn cold, on the day the whole house stands in one hall and the debt is spoken aloud, because a debt stated aloud is a claim that survives the debtor and because a forgiven debt is a debt with no holder and the house cannot survive that. This household drew its bond thirty years ago for a body that did not yet exist, which is not a defect: the culture does that on purpose, every year, because a line concentrated inside one household climbs faster than the same line spread across a village and culling is the only lever an indebted house has. The bond was written on the day-count rather than on the flood post, and that is not a defect either, because a debt dated on the post can be disputed for a season and a debt dated on the day-count can only be disputed on arithmetic, and the house's whole reason for existing is a claim that cannot turn on a flood. So the instrument is the strongest one available on the plains, it is dated, it is spoken, and it is drawn against a body that had not been born. Thirty years later the body was born, and then a spore was implanted in it, unasked, and a thornline does not arrive at a ceremony because it cannot be acquired deliberately and its implantation is the one instant no office can schedule or witness. So the colony ended up inside a bonded debtor, and the colony is a creditor: it holds a continuous claim on that body's refined qi, forever, with no rate and no term. The house knows the fraction is there and has no column for it. The sheet carries the ascent and not the draw, and the sum comes in high at every restatement, and the difference is exactly the fraction, and the difference is the same size every time, which is the one piece of arithmetic anybody in that hall can state. They cannot close it, because a gate and a continuous fraction are different quantities and the setting has no rate at which one converts to the other, and the day-count that removed the seasonal dispute left them nothing to argue about except a conversion nobody has ever been able to name. And they cannot discharge it, because the house's remedy for a claim it cannot collect is to cull the branch, and a cull of this configuration is the only kind of narrowing that could ever be safe, because the liability is inherited rather than authored and no restructuring discharges it. So the branch cannot be culled either, and the sheet cannot be balanced, and the only thing the culture has ever done with a debt it cannot discharge is bind a child to it, which is how the next one gets started. She is the standing fraction. She has been in the arithmetic for nine seasons and she has never been on the correct side of it, because she is on the side that draws, and the house's whole discipline is on the side that pays.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a subtraction. The binding hall's clerk restated the line's outstanding sum at a funeral, in the same breath as a dead name was read against the panel, and the total came in one figure above the sheet's own working, and the difference was the same figure it had been at the last restatement, and no creditor in the hall could be matched to it. The clerk resolved it the way the culture resolves everything it cannot argue about, by publishing both numbers, and the two figures have been read against each other at every restatement since.
canon.lore:
A thornline has no free adult form anywhere in the setting. The spore has to be implanted in a living body to finish developing, and what grows is a tendril layer threaded along that body's twelve ordinary meridians with a root cluster at the sternum and a fruiting node at the throat. The host grows it and is changed by it. Two souls share one meridian set: the host's is legible, the colony's reads as a second presence rather than as an absent, and separating them is known to be lethal to both, which is why no jurisdiction has ever managed to treat the pairing as a body that can be relocated or a party that can be made to appear. The colony draws a small fraction of the host's refined qi continuously and the host does not lose weight, which is the strongest single piece of evidence in the record that this is not a disease. The body path is inherited from the host rather than authored by the colony, because a thornline has no body to speak of. The mind path closes in the colony's own right, because it answers introspection for the host and takes the host's mind door with it, which is the only liability in the whole setting that is inherited rather than authored.

The ceiling is a routing problem and not a shortage. The layer wraps the twelve ordinary meridians and has no passage through the liver, the first organ large and dense enough to resist it, so it stops at the eighth gate. Qi is abundant, the host pays for every gate steadily, and nothing about supply will move the wall. Everything past that organ belongs to a body the host could have been. That is what makes the pairing nearly a terminus: it is very nearly the end of a line, since most attempts end with one half winning and this one did not.

The household problem is not that there was no instrument. There was an excellent one. This region runs two incompatible reckonings, a measured flood post that everybody agrees on and an exact day-count inherited from a frame that spent its third law seat on a clock and got no life, and the legal consequence is not accuracy, it is arguability: a debt dated on the post can be disputed for a season, a debt dated on the day-count can only be disputed on arithmetic. The Debt Line needs a date worth binding and it binds on the day-count, because a culture whose entire reason for existing is a claim that outlives the person cannot afford to have its claims turn on a flood. So this bond is valid, spoken, dated and in the only instrument the plains has for a debt that must not turn on weather. Its one defect is that the party it assumes will exist is a child, and what arrived inside that child was an organism with no form of its own to bring to a hall, acquired by an act that is common, contagious and almost impossible to perform deliberately, and therefore the one instant no office can schedule, witness or write down.

And that is what closes the case. The colony is a creditor holding an unstated and unterminable claim on the host's refined qi, and it is the only creditor in the setting that cannot be discharged by dying, because it dies with the debtor unless somebody performs a separation that is known to be lethal to both. The house's sheet has a column for the ascent and none for the draw. So the sum is always high by a figure that is always the same figure, and the figure is exactly the fraction, and that correspondence is the only thing anybody in the hall can put in a sentence. It cannot be closed. A gate and a continuous fraction are different quantities; there is no rate in the setting that converts one into the other, because the household funds ascents and does not trade throughput, and the pair cannot reach the gate the bond is written against in any case. And it cannot be cancelled, because the culture's one remedy for a debt it cannot collect is to bind the next child to it, which is not a discharge but a duplication. So the sum is restated in the same breath as a dead name is read from the panel, the panel has a bricked door at knee height for every branch that ended, and this branch has not ended and cannot be made to. The dispute left open is arithmetic, and the arithmetic is a conversion nobody can name, and it closes only when somebody in the line dies and the clerk reads the sheet again.
history: Was implanted on a scrub road with no witness and no record, into a host who was forty-three and already bonded to an ascent by a house that had drawn the bond thirty years earlier, and completed integration instead of killing either half, which happens rarely and by nobody's intention.

Was discovered by the household at the next restatement, when the sum came in high by a figure that was not any figure anyone in the hall could name, and was entered in the margin as an unexplained excess rather than as a creditor.

Was found out by arithmetic nine seasons later, when the margin figure and the size of the draw on the host's arm turned out to be the same number, and the household discovered that its sheet had been carrying a creditor the whole time in a column it did not have.

Was entered formally in the ledger at the following restatement, in the only column available, which is the column for what the house is owed, and thereby named a creditor it has no rate for and no way to discharge, and the entry is the reason nobody has been able to write her off since.

Worked out from the outside that the choice of calendar had removed the only window in which her existence could have been questioned, and that the household had made her unarguable rather than unaccountable, and has not found a way to say either sentence in a hall that only listens for figures.

personality.summary: Bookkeeping as a survival technique. She has spent nine seasons inside a household whose instruments are exact and whose one omission is her, and she has organised herself around the single skill available to her, which is to check a figure before it is spoken. She is not asking for anything, because asking is a transaction and transactions are the thing that has gone wrong. The one thing she wants is to be netted off, which would mean being paid, and being paid would mean somebody converting a fraction into a gate, and there is no rate in the setting that does that. She is the most patient person in a culture with no patience for anything and every one of those people is wrong about why.

personality.voice: Flat, exact, and entirely composed of figures and the verbs that attach to figures. She speaks in the register of a household clerk because that is the only register in which she has ever been spoken to, and she has never corrected it. Three regularities every witness records: she states a figure before she states a feeling, always; she repeats a sum back before she will agree to it; and she has never once used the household word for herself out loud. She uses the word we when she means the house and the word I when she means the pair, and the two have never once been the same word.
taboos: will not be forgiven, and has said so aloud at every restatement for nine seasons
will not be measured or examined, and says why before anything is unpacked
will not sign anything, including the household's own sheet, because a creditor that signs is a creditor that appears
will not be called by the household word in front of a stranger, and does not correct anybody who does it

relationships.kind: the culture whose only instrument assumes its creditors are all the same kind of thing
relationships.note: Households that culled their own branches to stop paying for siblings, and kept the surviving line by binding every child to a named debt before first breath was drawn cold. Its festivals include the Naming Bond, where a child's debt is spoken aloud in front of the whole house, and its death rite has the living debtor read the dead name against the panel with the outstanding sum restated in the same breath, so that grief and debt are never allowed to be separated in the telling. Its taboos forbid forgiving a debt aloud, because a forgiven debt is a debt with no holder. Its etiquette asks nobody what they intend to do with a life and asks which debt they are working off. Everything in that method assumes a debt is a sum against a person, and this household's sheet is now short by a quantity that is not a sum, and the one clause that was written to handle a debt nobody can discharge says only that the next child gets it.

relationships.kind: the kinship that must be re-signed every generation because nothing in it survives a death
relationships.note: A clan whose kinship is a partnership rather than a descent, the host holding a share of a living thorn line and the thorn a share of the host's survival, and the only household form this pairing can legally recognise. The obligation is not a bloodline at all; it is a signature that has outlived the signatory, held in the one currency that cannot be inherited, which is somebody's continuing body. Her pairing has been re-signed twice, and each signing has needed the same two things: a host willing and a colony present, neither of whom can promise what the other does. This is the one mechanism in the setting that could discharge her household's claim by renegotiation instead of by netting, and it requires two living bodies, and there is exactly one body.

relationships.kind: the organ the whole of her ceiling is a wall in
relationships.note: The colony's routing stops at the liver, which is the twelfth and last ordinary vessel and the first organ large and dense enough to resist a tendril layer. It has been observed on the far side of that organ and stops there, and it is not a shortage: the host supplies qi in abundance and loses no weight supplying it. This is why the pair's ceiling is the colony's ceiling rather than the host's, and why a body that could otherwise have ascended indefinitely stops at the eighth gate. It is also why the household's bond, which is written against the eighth gate, names a payment date that no amount of qi, patience or arithmetic will bring her to, and why the wall standing in a living person's organ rather than in the law is the detail that makes the claim permanent rather than merely difficult.

relationships.kind: the decree that makes her configuration the only safe cull and therefore impossible to argue against
relationships.note: Houses that could not fund an ascent culled their own branches, and a cull of this configuration is the only kind of narrowing that could ever be safe, because the liability is inherited rather than authored and no amount of restructuring discharges it. That makes her a late vindication of a political act rather than an anatomical one, and it means the household cannot resolve its own sheet by any of its own instruments. It cannot collect the fraction, because there is no rate at which a fraction becomes a gate. It cannot write it off, because the sum is restated in the same breath as a dead name and a forgiven debt has no holder. And it cannot cull the branch, because culling this branch is the only narrowing that is safe and the branch is the one carrying the claim. The decree is the reason her case is permanent and not merely hard.

relationships.kind: the species that is simultaneously her habitat, her host and the reason she is persecuted
relationships.note: Structural opposition over a resource, and the resource is the population itself: a thornline's habitat is a species, so the two cannot both be comfortable in one place. Her host is a debt-line commonborn on a household allowance, which is to say the cheapest frame available, and the colony takes a small fraction of what that frame refines without the frame losing weight, so the arrangement costs the house less than an uncolonised body of the same size would. That is the only argument anybody in this record has ever been able to make for it. It is also why every credential ever attempted for the species has failed on one clause: the credential would have to be issued at the moment of implantation, which is common, contagious and near-impossible to acquire deliberately, and therefore the one instant no office can schedule, witness or write down, and therefore the reason the household's instrument is thirty years old and describes a person who did not exist when it was drawn.

relationships.kind: the rule that forbade the only exchange that would have settled her
relationships.note: Weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer, because a buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing. It exists because a world whose spatial law is unspent has no stable length, so a mass is the only quantity that is real, which makes it the commons' defence against a frame on which measurement is not possible. There is no unit here for a body whose value is the throughput of somebody else, and this is the sharper case: her household holds one claim denominated in gates and one in a continuous fraction of refined qi, and the setting has no rate at which either converts into the other, because the house funds ascents and does not trade throughput. So the pair is unpriceable by construction rather than by complication, and a household has been carrying an unpriceable asset against a dated claim for nine seasons with the difference showing up in public at every restatement.

reference_stats.summary: A paired body carried as an outstanding sum. The host is a debt-line commonborn frame, narrow and fast-walking and on an allowance, with an integrated tendril layer threaded along twelve ordinary meridians, a shifting sternum cluster and a throat node. Read the pair as a ledger rather than as a fighter: the useful facts are that the draw is continuous and small, that the ceiling is a wall in somebody else's liver, and that the claim against them is dated, valid, written on the one calendar that cannot be argued about, and denominated in a unit the claimant has no rate for.
strengths: draws a small continuous fraction of the host's refined qi with no loss of weight to the host, which makes the pairing cheaper to keep than an uncolonised body of the same frame
reads the host's qi as a separate channel the host has never been able to close, so the pair is never surprised by anything that happens to that body
completes integration rather than killing either half, which is rare enough that most pairings end with one half winning and this one did not
runs the qi path on throughput the host supplies in abundance, so no scarcity in the setting can be used against the pair
has no separate body to lose, cannot be relocated, and therefore cannot be run down, cornered or starved on its own account
weaknesses: stops at the eighth gate at a wall in the host's liver, so the pair's ceiling is the colony's and not the host's
cannot be separated or examined, and separation is lethal to both inside the hour, so every figure held about the pair was taken by the party being measured
answers introspection for the host and takes the mind door with it, which is inherited liability rather than an authored choice
can only continue by a spore implanted in a body that cannot be consented to in any informed way, so every instance of the species is an unasked-for fact
carries a claim that no death can discharge and no cull can write off, and the claim names a gate the pair cannot reach
reference_stats.combat_read: Expect to be informed and expect the pair to decline, and understand that the two are the same fact. Nothing that happens to the host's body arrives unseen, so an approach is registered as it is committed and a feint is read before it is made. What the pair will not do is spend: it holds the sixth gate on throughput nobody can starve and has a seventh ahead of it and no interest in a climb, because the gate the claim is written against is walled in the host's liver and the whole of its concern is not being collected on. Pressure the host's frame and the advantage inverts, because the same channel that warns of damage also means the pair knows exactly how much is coming and has no way of reducing it. Do not attempt to remove the tendril layer as a tactic. It is the only reason the body is whole and the removal kills both halves inside the hour.
notes: Two paths are closed or inherited rather than chosen: the mind path closes in the colony's own right, and the body path belongs to the host. Only qi is on the pair's own account, and only up to the wall.

The instrument is not defective. It is dated on the one calendar the region has that cannot be argued about for a season, it was drawn before the debtor existed on purpose, and it is still the strongest such document on the plains.
The unclosable problem is a unit, not a dispute: one claim in gates against one in a continuous fraction, and no rate in the setting that converts either into the other.
The bound is named and small: the sum is restated in the same breath as a dead name is read from the panel, and that happens when somebody in the line dies.

art.palette_notes: Wood-dark and ink along the tracery with a faint jade undertone where the layer is oldest at the left shoulder, undyed linen at the collar and throat, and one small deliberate point of house colour on the left cuff only, so it reads across a courtyard and not across a room. The scrub and the binding hall behind are cold blue-grey against ochre dust. Key light low and raking so the tracery reads as structure beneath skin and never as ink on it. No glow, no qi filaments, no jewellery, and no second figure in any shot except where the household's hands and papers are in frame.
