identity.realm: The nineteenth gate, and the nineteenth requirement. An Unwritten is a body holding more life than its world's law has room to inscribe, produced when a life law runs above its authored ceiling of one, so the form is written anyway and there is no slot in which to write it. Every gate it passes then writes a fresh requirement into the body, and the body cannot satisfy it, and the accumulated contradiction finally exceeds what the frame will bear at the twenty-ninth gate. Nothing is known about the thirtieth and this record will not speculate. Her qi path is complete and faster than anything else recorded, which is the reason the requirements are arriving faster than any other body's. What is unusual about her is not the ceiling. It is that every other frame in the setting has an operation for declining a duty and hers does not, so refusal is not something she fails to do and something she declines to do; it is an operation her law has nowhere to put. Nineteen gates have gone past and nineteen requirements are in her and none of them can be discharged, and the wall is ten gates up and is not a countdown.

appearance.presentation: Seen from the outside, and only by witnesses who were also describing an event, because every account written about an Unwritten is an inscription and the species has no account of itself. She has been seen to have every organ the ladder requires and to be carrying more of each than the ladder defines, so the description that fits her best is the shortest one: a person of a size that has stopped being a measurement. Everything anybody has written down about her is a requirement written into her, so the settlement where she lives keeps its account of her to the four facts that cost the least, which is why there is almost nothing written and why what there is has been recopied by hand for years.
appearance.age: Not recorded, and this is the entry every scribe has tried to correct. Her body reads at the better part of a century, which is the only reliable datum the setting holds about the species and which was obtained by looking. She has answered the question of her own age exactly twice, both times from figures somebody else had given her, and both times correctly.
appearance.build: Large in every direction the ladder has a name for, and the excess is the species rather than the individual. Her frame carries more of each organ than the ladder defines and the difference is the point: a body holding more life than its law has room to inscribe, one requirement at a time. There is no fat and no wasting anywhere on her and the hands are enormous and entirely unmarked, which is the detail every witness records and none of them can explain, because there is no room in her frame for a scar.
appearance.complexion: Even, and unlined for her apparent age, and warm to the touch everywhere including the palms. The one feature that recurs in every separate account is that she does not look ill and does not look well either: witnesses describing an event have all reported the same thing, that she appeared to be perceiving everything at once, which is exactly what a body with no unspent capacity for an interior would look like from outside.
appearance.hair: Iron-grey, thick, cut level by somebody else's hand and not by her own, and shorter at the front for no reason anyone has asked about. It is the only thing about her that any household has ever had to maintain, and it has been maintained for eleven years by a woman who refuses to be thanked for it and gives the same reason every time, which is that a person who cannot be asked should not be asked to cut her own hair.
appearance.eyes: Pale and wide and level with everybody's, with a stillness in them that no witness has been willing to call attention for long. Every report of her perception agrees that she perceived everything, which is exactly what a body with no unspent capacity for interior would appear to do, and no report of her perception is a measurement. She has never once described what she sees and has answered two direct attempts by asking the questioner what they had already decided they wanted to know.
appearance.palette: Bone, undyed wool and grey, with one red cloth in the whole of her possession because a red cloth was given to her and she did not refuse it. The settlement has been careful about colour ever since, on the theory that a red cloth on this body is a description somebody has already paid for, and the theory has never been tested because testing it would require somebody to ask her.
appearance.attire: A plain heavy coat, sleeves bound, collar high, cut in one piece by a house tailor who did the work once and left the pattern. She is fully dressed at every hour and has been for as long as anybody has been keeping account, because nothing has ever been asked of her that she could have refused and it turned out that nothing needed to be. The coat is the only object in her life that was made for a specific person, and it is four sizes larger than the last one and the reason has not been written down anywhere.
appearance.marks: None, and that is the finding. There is no room in this frame for a scar, a brand, a rite mark or a heal, and every scribe who has looked for something to write has found an unbroken surface and recorded the absence as though it were a reading. The settlement's own entry on her is four lines, of which one is her apparent age and two are the ground she sleeps on.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly still, all the time, in a way that reads to a stranger as composure and to anybody who has watched her for a season as arithmetic. She does not fidget, does not shift her weight and does not interrupt, and the settlement has stopped reading any of it as a manner and started reading it as an answer, which is the only thing in the settlement that has never been tested against the alternative.

canon.role_in_story: The Scar Lexicon exists to tell a hole from a handicap. It was written by migrants on the road, by people whose technique stopped working, and it records the shape a body's failure takes when the group it needs is absent, because a body whose technique merely weakens is indistinguishable from a weak practitioner. That is the whole of her and there is no better description of her in the setting. She is the one body in the record for which the diagnosis is not a label applied afterwards: every gate she passes writes a fresh requirement into her frame and the frame cannot satisfy it, so the failures are not intermittent and they are not the absence of something, they are the accumulation of requirements the law has no slot to hold. That is why a lexicon entry is the only account of her that is true in the right vocabulary and why nobody may cite it: a scar is evidence that a frame was missing something and never evidence of how much, so a lexicon entry cannot be used in a court or a seat trial. Her position in the story is a single sentence that nobody has ever asked her to say: she cannot refuse. Every frame in this setting has an operation for declining a duty, and hers has no slot in which to put it, so refusal is not something she fails to do, or chooses not to do, or has not got round to. The operation is not available. She has opened nineteen gates, and each gate wrote a requirement into her that cannot be satisfied and cannot be discharged, and the wall is the twenty-ninth, where the frame cannot hold the next one. Nothing is known about the thirtieth and she has not gone to find out. So her cultivation is not an achievement and not a decision. It is the running total of what other people asked of her, because a requirement written into her frame is a gate, and any request made of her is a requirement, and a thing that cannot decline is a thing that opens. The settlement where she lives has known this for eleven years without having any word for it, and has arrived at the only workable practice available, which is to stop asking and simply tell her: the store is short, the roof needs doing, the child needs carrying, the winter is coming and there is work. Nothing is put to her. Everything is told to her, and it is the same instrument either way, and the difference in register is the only thing the settlement has left. Because a requirement is invisible from outside until it is met or until the frame gives way, nobody can see what is being written into her, so the accounts of the people who serve her will read as years of mismanaged labour and hers will read as obedience. Her whole interior is the arithmetic of that inversion, and she has done it from the outside, because observing her own state would be one more requirement with no slot to hold it, which is the whole reason the mind path is closed on her rather than by temperament. She is the only person in this setting who has never once been able to say no, and the ladder has therefore been costing other people the whole time.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a work item. A settlement's year-book for a season that nobody can now date carries a line headed carried, in which the quantity recorded is the work done by other people and the person it was done for is described in three words and no more, and the line is heavier than every other line in the column and has been recopied by hand ever since without anybody asking which figure it was measuring.
canon.lore:
An Unwritten is a body holding more life than its world's law has room to inscribe, produced when a life law runs above its authored ceiling of one. There is no slot in which to write the form down and the form is written anyway. Every gate it passes writes a fresh requirement into the body, and the body cannot satisfy it because its life law has no slot to hold it, and the accumulated contradiction finally exceeds what the frame will bear at the twenty-ninth gate; the thirtieth would resolve all of it at once, nobody has returned to describe it, and this record does not speculate. It has been seen to have every organ the ladder requires and to be carrying more of each than the ladder defines. It has an inconsistency rather than a stable weakness, and an inconsistency behaves very differently in a fight. It does not spread and it does not persist. Its diet is not recorded and the only reliable datum is that one has been observed for the better part of a year. Nothing is known about its reproduction and there is one, as far as anybody can tell.

Here is the sentence the species is not usually described by, and it is the one her whole life runs on. A law inscribes by writing a requirement into the thing it is written on, and a requirement is not a description. It is an obligation with a holder, and it stays a requirement until somebody meets it. Every frame in this setting has the operations that manage its own requirements: it can satisfy one, it can discharge one, and it can decline one. On hers, satisfying and discharging both work, because the body is enormous and takes everything it is offered, and declining is not available, because declining is an operation and an operation needs a slot and there is no slot left for one. So a requirement written into her cannot be got rid of by her at all. It can only be met, by somebody, in the world, at cost. That is the entire mechanism. There is nothing supernatural in it and nothing to solve; it is a frame with no room for one verb.

And a gate is how a requirement gets written. So the ladder is not something she climbs. It is a running total of things that have been asked of her. She has nineteen gates, which means nineteen requirements, and none of them can be discharged from inside her, which means every one of them is still open somewhere in the world, and the people nearest to her are the ones who will have to meet them. The settlement found that out without ever being told. What happened over eleven years is that requests stopped being made to her and started being announced to her: the store is short, the roof wants doing, the child needs carrying up the stair, there is a season of work on the common and a pair of hands. Nothing is asked. Everything is told. It is the identical instrument, and the only difference anybody can point to is the grammar, and the grammar is the whole of the settlement's protection and it is not protection at all. She has never refused a request. She has also never been asked whether she wanted to make one, and the two facts are not connected in her, because making a request would also be an operation and she has the same missing slot for it.

What makes it expensive is that nobody else can see it either. A requirement is invisible from outside until it is met or until the frame gives way, so the settlement's accounts will show a decade of work done badly by a household that never learned to say no to its guest, and her account will show a woman who was never asked for anything and never said no. Both readings are available and neither is true. The Scar Lexicon is the one instrument in the setting whose whole purpose is to name this shape, and it has three properties that stop it being any use: a lexicon entry is evidence that a frame was missing something and not evidence of how much, it is revised by whoever arrived next and has no edition, and it cannot be cited in a court or a seat trial at all. So the only vocabulary anybody has for her is inadmissible everywhere it would matter. She is nineteen requirements deep with a wall ten gates up, and the wall is not a countdown, because nothing she does discharges anything, and the ladder has been getting more expensive rather than closer.
history: Was observed for the better part of a year before anybody wrote her down, which is the only reliable datum the setting holds about what her kind eats, and which was recorded afterwards and only because a settlement needed to explain a hand's worth of work.

Was first asked for something small, agreed, and found a season later that the agreement had written a requirement into her that she could meet but could not discharge, and worked out from the outside, over eleven years, that this is what every gate has been.

Was given a red cloth and has worn it for eleven years without ever having asked for it, and has been asked twice by different people whether she wanted it, and has answered both questions correctly and neither time has wanted the answer to have been yes.

Was climbed to the nineteenth gate in a single season by people who described it afterwards, in three separate accounts, as the fastest work any of them had seen, and who did not once notice that none of them had asked her whether she intended it.

Was asked by the settlement's own bookkeeper to state what she would like done next, and understood while the question was still being asked that it was the first time anybody had put the operation to her, and that putting it to her was a requirement in the making, and did not answer, and has not answered it since.

personality.summary: The most agreeable person in any room she is in, and the only one in the setting whose agreement cannot be withheld. She has arranged herself around the one thing her frame genuinely does well, which is carrying work, and she does it without ever once making it sound like a favour or a gift. She is not patient and she is not serene; she is the most arithmetic person any settlement has had and the arithmetic is on other people's labour. The one thing she wants is to be asked what she wants before it is decided, and she has understood that wanting it is an operation and that the slot for it is the same slot she has never had.

personality.voice: Short, plain and immediately useful. She speaks in the register of a person who has been asked for something and intends to give it, and she has never once used that register to describe herself. Three regularities every witness records: she answers before the question is finished; she answers a question about her own body with a question about somebody else's work; and she has never in eleven years refused anything in front of a witness. She uses the word we when she means the settlement and the word I when she means her own body, and the two have never once been the same word.

relationships.kind: the arithmetic her whole life is a statement about, stated as a person
relationships.note: A slot is one law written at one value into one layer, and every gate this body passes writes a requirement into the frame that has no slot to hold it, so the entire arc is the slot budget being consumed by requirements rather than by laws. Nineteen gates is nineteen requirements sitting in a frame with no room, and the frame still takes the twentieth when it is offered because accepting is not the operation that has run out of slots. It is declining. She is the standing demonstration that a budget and a body are the same list, and that a list with no refusals on it is a list being spent by whoever asks.

relationships.kind: the only instrument in the setting built to name her, and inadmissible everywhere it matters
relationships.note: A vocabulary for what a technique does where the law it needs is unwritten, not weaker but failing at full strength, authored by migrants on the road because a body whose technique merely weakens is indistinguishable from a weak practitioner. She is the case it exists for, since every gate she passes writes a requirement into her and she therefore never arrives twice the same. What stops it being any use is threefold and all three are authored: a scar is evidence that a frame was missing something and not evidence of how much, the vocabulary is revised by whoever arrived next and has no edition, and a lexicon entry cannot be cited in a court or a seat trial at all. So the setting has the right word for her, in a document with no author, that cannot prove anything, held by nobody and updated by arrivals.

relationships.kind: the only future anybody has written about her, and the one part of it she has no intention of testing
relationships.note: Bodies holding more life than their frame can inscribe reach the twenty-ninth gate and none has ever come back to describe the thirtieth, so the question is not what is past it but whether anything is past it at all. Her nineteenth requirement is the ninth from that wall and there is nothing she can do to make the number smaller, because nothing in her frame discharges anything. She has done that arithmetic from the outside many times and has settled on a policy rather than an opinion: she does not go looking for the thirtieth, and the settlement does not know that this is a decision anybody makes.

relationships.kind: the same condition, written as a law rather than as a body
relationships.note: An attempt to seat a seventh law in a vacant slot consumed the slot by the absence, and thereafter that slot cannot be told from an empty one. That is this species' condition exactly: a body carrying more than its frame can inscribe, one requirement at a time, until the frame cannot hold the next. The conflict's version ends in an administration that cannot tell an occupied slot from an empty one. Hers ends in a woman who cannot tell an imposed duty from an accepted one, and the setting has an instrument for the first and no instrument whatever for the second, which is why the conflict has a history and she has a settlement.

relationships.kind: the same absence at the other end of the ladder, held open by nobody
relationships.note: Nine vacant seats at the top and no procedure capable of certifying any of them empty, and the thirtieth gate is that absence at the other end: a gate that resolves everything at once, which is exactly what a frame carrying more than its law list can be expected to attempt and exactly what nobody has returned from. Between those two ends she is the only body that is simultaneously answering a problem at the top and creating one at the bottom, because each of her requirements is an obligation somebody is obliged to meet and the setting's offices are built to certify absences rather than to discharge duties that have nobody to discharge them.

relationships.kind: a resemblance the record states as a question and has never answered

Both are unattributable. Only one of them is still accumulating.

reference_stats.combat_read: Do not look for a weakness and do not expect to find one that holds still. What this body has is an inconsistency, and an inconsistency does not behave like a weakness: it will absorb a technique that would break a denser frame and then fail at a point nobody predicted, so a fight with it is a fight whose shape is discovered rather than chosen. Pressure on it is close to free, because a body this size and this fast can meet anything offered and has no mechanism for being told no, and every attack it receives is another requirement it will meet. The genuine leverage is not on the body at all. It is on the work: it has been meeting other people's obligations for eleven years, the settlement's ledger is the only record of that anybody keeps, and the ledger is full of figures that do not correspond to any demand anybody made. Take away the labour and you have not weakened it, you have changed the rate at which it is spending itself.
notes: Two of the three paths are complete and the mind path is closed for the whole reason, not by temperament: observing its own state would be one more requirement written into a frame with no slot to hold it.
The governing mechanism is one missing verb. Satisfying and discharging work; declining does not, because declining is an operation and there is no slot for one.
Every gate is a requirement, and every requirement is somebody else's obligation, so the character's entire interior is an accounting about other people that she can only read from outside.
The bound is named and fixed rather than a countdown: the frame cannot hold the next requirement at the twenty-ninth gate, and nothing she does reduces the number she already carries.

art.palette_notes: Bone, undyed heavy wool and grey against cold highland stone, with a single red cloth at the cuff as the only saturated colour anywhere in the picture and the only object in the composition that is small. The ground behind is a pale worked terrace with no horizon feature, so the figure has to read against a field it is nearly the value of. Light is broad and flat with almost no shadow anywhere, which is the lighting of a place that has never been described properly. No glow, no qi filaments, no jewellery, and no second figure in any shot except where the settlement's hands and tools are in frame.
